title: Assembling componentwise affine approximations into a vector affine map
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ continuous, s > 0 and A, B, Q, t ∈ ℝ. Suppose that for every j ∈ Fin k there are a ∈ ℝ and a continuous linear functional b on ℝⁿ with ‖b‖ ≤ B, |a| ≤ A and ∫_{B̆ⁿ_t(0)} (s⁻¹fʲ(v) − a − b(v))² dv ≤ Q (Bochner integral over the open ball; fʲ := EuclideanSpace.proj j ∘ f). Then there are c ∈ ℝᵏ and a continuous linear Λ : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |c| ≤ k·s·A, ‖Λ‖ ≤ k·s·B and ∫_{B̆ⁿ_t(0)} |f(v) − c − Λv|² dv ≤ k·s²·Q, the last as the lower integral of ENNReal.ofReal bounded by ENNReal.ofReal(k s² Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (s A B Q t : ℝ), Continuous f → 0 < s → (∀ j : Fin k, ∃ (a : ℝ) (b : Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ), ‖b‖ ≤ B ∧ |a| ≤ A ∧ ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) t, (s⁻¹ * EuclideanSpace.proj j (f v) - a - b v) ^ 2 ≤ Q) → ∃ (c : Euclid k) (Λ : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), ‖c‖ ≤ k * s * A ∧ ‖Λ‖ ≤ k * s * B ∧ ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) t, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f v - c - Λ v‖ ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (k * s ^ 2 * Q)
